g.text: C23 saved results: restore escrow and completion-record retirement
retain A while old-current B disposes
protected publication requires managed adapter; not raw equivalence
commit only after known B and C settlement
retain opaque operation and provider; do not retry hook
saved results, ACK producers and observers can still refer
close is not a grace period
result closure and completion evidence also required
stable anchor rejects old ACK before record access
